svg.title: A clip is a bundle of independent channels
svg.desc: On the left, a pose array: every joint sampled at every frame. On the right, the same motion as per-channel tracks after reduction, where most channels are empty and the rest keep their own key times.
svg.text: one clip, one second, twenty-three joints
baked at 30 Hz into every channel, then reduced — the map is what survived
each channel keeps its own times
16 of 69 channels carry anything at all; every scale channel is gone, and so is
every position but the root’s — 3,716 bytes against the pose array’s 28,520.
